purpose: Source-backed game reference. Production lookup and development evidence use separate routes; analysis and serving belong to downstream repositories.

conventions.canonical_identifiers: Stable game database keys are authoritative; localized labels are descriptive.
conventions.blank_values: Blank means not applicable or unavailable from the decoded source relation.
conventions.zero_values: Zero means an observed numeric zero.
conventions.percentages: Percentage-like values are stored as percentage points unless a schema inventory says otherwise.
conventions.lists: One-to-many relationships are represented as typed rows or lookup tables, not delimited cells.
conventions.generated_files: Do not edit production CSV files or the GeoPackage by hand.

agent_loading_strategy: Read this catalog and the selected dataset README first.
Read the dataset manifest and schema inventory before loading record files.
Use an index to select only relevant race, faction, character, or table files.
Filter CSV rows or query the GeoPackage instead of placing entire large datasets in model context.
Check the validation report and preserve documented caveats in the answer.
Use faction guides for mechanics that the normalized datasets deliberately omit.

units.description: Unit statistics and relational combat lookups for 25 race rosters (3,181 roster rows). Culture-qualified ability links are conditional.
units.preferred_access: Select the race CSV, then join typed lookup rows by stable keys.

skill_trees.description: Skill trees for 550 distinct character subtypes, including conditional node sets, prerequisites, locks and effects; two reviewed pairs share source tree structures.
skill_trees.preferred_access: Use the character index to locate one character file, then filter by record_type and node_set_key.

economy.description: Standardized building and ordinary economy facts for 109 playable faction keys.
economy.preferred_access: Use the faction index to locate one faction file; consult faction guides for deliberately omitted bespoke mechanics.

campaign_map.description: Queryable Immortal Empires geography, starts, objectives, topology, and battle-map relationships; atlas schema 1.3 preserves all 1,136 map/group/catchment/tile variants.
campaign_map.preferred_access: For starting-army questions, query faction_army_start_reference by faction_key and apply campaign_start_partner_overrides for the selected human partner. faction_start_reference describes capitals, not armies. For other atlas questions use the narrow views in the main README; do not scan raw startpos evidence.

starting_positions.scope: Starting positions only; not the full atlas schema. Raw evidence is for provenance checks, not default lookup.

objectives.scope: Initial single-player configured objectives. Filter variant_key (Vlad/Isabella differ), then read objective_boundaries for runtime dependencies; not complete effective runtime objectives.

faction_guides.description: Qualitative, source-backed campaign mechanics not represented safely in the normalized catalogs.
faction_guides.preferred_access: Read COMPATIBILITY_9.0.md before any historical race guide. Never use unreviewed 8.1.1 mechanics as verified 9.0 facts; current numeric/relational facts belong to the 9.0 databases.

technology_trees.description: 109 faction technology files with current selectors, nodes, effects and bounded scripted evidence. Nagash has an explicitly empty ordinary technology selector; Black Pyramid progression is outside normalization.
technology_trees.preferred_access: Filter one faction file by record_type and variant_key. Faction-specific overrides replace generic fallbacks; the Changeling has only ROC and IE variants. Typed script requirements/rewards preserve scope, triggers, targets and thresholds. Read the explicit remaining lock-site limitations in script_audit.json.

magic.description: Partial character-to-spell retrieval with normalized shared payload graphs, conditional skill bindings, unit/form access evidence and separate structural/runtime coverage; 9.0.1 extraction joins unchanged 9.0 owners.
magic.preferred_access: Resolve an exact character name/subtype or ability label/key through the compact indices; use scripts/query_magic.py. Keep base payloads and conditional skill modifiers separate; read coverage boundaries.

shared_abilities.description: Native shared ability, casting, phase, lifecycle and payload companion definitions; bounded 9.0.1 evidence.
shared_abilities.preferred_access: Use the selected unit or magic retrieval route first; inspect this owner for exact native relations and provenance. Preserve partial coverage and unresolved runtime behavior.

effect_semantics.description: Native effect bindings, stat and scope/context definitions; partial semantics, not a campaign modifier resolver.
effect_semantics.preferred_access: Use the selected unit or magic retrieval route first; inspect this owner for exact native relations and provenance. Preserve partial coverage and unresolved runtime behavior.

out_of_scope: Live game state and save files
Changes outside each owner's declared snapshot; scoped 9.0.1 additions and historical 8.1.1 guides are explicitly identified, not a global migration.
Mods unless explicitly represented in a future dataset
Runtime effects that are not exposed by decoded source relations or documented guides

cold_mires_hypothesis.description: Experimental one-map terrain hypothesis: elevation, conditional water, vegetation points and candidate blockage polygons. Not verified navigation.
cold_mires_hypothesis.preferred_access: Use point/region/summary queries; carry coordinate, selection and runtime uncertainty. Read EXTRACTION.md to rebuild from pinned assets.

maintenance_loading_strategy: Read repository boundaries and connection contracts before proposing a new owner or extraction.
Consult the dated development inventory; refresh relevant issue/PR state and immutable refs before implementation.
Inspect targeted owner manifests, schemas and audits; preserve generated-data paths and downstream pins.
Update affected contracts, documentation and validation in the same PR.
